title: Monomial on a prefixed sign assignment
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set of coordinates among $n$, let $b$ be a sign, and let $x$ be a sign assignment on those $n$ coordinates. Prefix $x$ by $b$, and shift the coordinates of $S$ one position to the right. The monomial on the set consisting of coordinate $0$ and those shifted coordinates equals the sign represented by $b$ times the monomial on $S$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates among $n$
$x$ is a sign assignment on $n$ coordinates
